text: Monday morning, sunshine knocks the window
Early morning, you say some words I don't know
Don't leave the shadow on my desk again and again
Sunset falling, leave your smile on the road.
We walk together, let our heart get close.
The dreams we're dreaming, never fade away, I know.
When this summer's gone,
I won't be alone.
When this summer's gone,
We'll know where we belong.
We shout it out until the end of story,
Here we're standing without fear
Don't be worried
We're young and wild and free of mind
We run to tomorrow, leave the past behind
No matter if we are the chosen one,
a better one, or just begun,
we still chase the sun.
